title: Reference Payload (v1) — Reference-plane entity
description: Phase 16 — Reference plane entities (teams, players, venues). Per EMITTER.md §3.3, slow-changing records are never deleted, only retired_at is set. JSONSchema ensures payload conforms before emitter writes.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, null if not applicable.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the reference source last confirmed this record.

retired_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the entity was retired (e.g., team folded, player retired). Null if active.
